description: Weapon and totem mastery - strike as a warrior, or stand as the earth itself.

nodes.name: Enhancing Totems
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth Totem by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases the effect of your Strength of Earth and Flametongue Totems by 5%/10%/15%.' There is no Flametongue Totem (Flametongue Weapon exists, which is a different thing). ability_<id>_potency scales the ability's own stat_mods. Kept from the outgoing tree, which also modified Windfury Totem - that is Improved Windfury Totem's job two tiers down.

nodes.name: Ancestral Knowledge
nodes.description: Increases your Intellect by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 0: 'Increases your Intellect by 2%-10%.' Built verbatim. The outgoing version granted max_mana_pct, which is downstream of Intellect rather than the talent. intellect_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS and this node feeds Mental Dexterity at tier 2, which is the pairing that makes an Enhancement shaman's attack power work.

nodes.name: Shield Specialization
nodes.description: Increases Block by 2% per rank, and blocking has a 10% chance per rank to restore 30 Mana.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly - same id, effects, proc, values and position. Not a WotLK talent. Verified live before this rebuild: block +10 at full rank. It sits in the main body rather than the tank column because block plus mana-on-being-hit serves both roles.

nodes.name: Guardian Totems
nodes.description: Increases the armor your Stoneskin Totem grants by 10% per rank and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim: 'Increases the amount of armor increased by your Stoneskin Totem by 10%/20% and reduces the cooldown of your Grounding Totem by 5/10 sec.' Both real totems exist and both now sit in the Earth and Air element slots respectively. Kept from the outgoing tree, which had it as totem DURATION rather than potency.

nodes.name: Elemental Weapons
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Windfury Weapon and Flametongue Weapon by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Increases the damage caused by your Windfury Weapon effect by 13%-40%, increases the spell damage on your Flametongue Weapon.' Both weapon imbues exist here as real abilities. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict and no proc - it did nothing at all for 3 points.

nodes.name: Thundering Strikes
nodes.description: Increases your critical strike chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1: 'Improves your chance to get a critical strike with all spells and attacks by 1%-5%.' Built verbatim and kept from the outgoing tree. It is Flurry's prerequisite in the real tree, preserved below.

nodes.name: Shamanistic Focus
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your Shock spells by 45%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, built verbatim at the real 45% across all three Shock spells. Kept from the outgoing tree, which used the FLAT _cost key - a 45% reduction cannot be expressed that way. _cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION.

nodes.name: Anticipation
nodes.description: Increases your dodge chance by 1% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 1, NEW to our tree: 'Increases your chance to dodge by an additional 1%-3%, and reduces the duration of all Disarm effects used against you.' The dodge half is built; Disarm duration is not modifiable. This is a real WotLK Enhancement talent that happens to serve the tank path too, which is the kind of overlap a dual-role tree wants.

nodes.name: Improved Windfury Totem
nodes.description: Increases the effect of your Windfury Totem by 10% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases the melee haste granted by your Windfury totem by 2%/4%.' Built as potency, which scales the totem's own stat_mods. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict and no proc.

nodes.name: Flurry
nodes.description: Your critical strikes have a 20% chance per rank to quicken your attacks by 30% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases your attack speed by 6%-30% for your next 3 swings after dealing a critical strike.' Built with the real 30% at full rank. 'Next 3 swings' is not expressible - nothing counts swings or consumes a buff on use - so it is a 2-turn window. Ranked by chance, since a proc's payload does not scale with points. The real talent requires Thundering Strikes, which connected_to reproduces. Kept as a proc from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Spirit Weapons
nodes.description: Grants a chance to parry and reduces your threat by 30%.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim with both halves: 'Gives a chance to parry enemy melee attacks and reduces all threat generated by 30%.' parry is PERCENTAGE POINTS and threat_generation_pct is a FRACTION. Kept from the outgoing tree. NOTE the threat reduction is the opposite of what the tank path wants, which is a real and interesting tension in a dual-role tree rather than a flaw.

nodes.name: Toughness
nodes.description: Increases your Stamina by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2: 'Increases your Stamina by 2%-10%, and reduces the duration of movement slowing effects on you by 30%.' The Stamina half is built verbatim; movement slowing does not exist. stamina_pct is PERCENTAGE POINTS. Kept from the outgoing tree.

nodes.name: Mental Dexterity
nodes.description: Increases your attack power by 33% of your Intellect per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 2, built verbatim: 'Increases your Attack Power by 33%-100% of your Intellect.' A REAL stat conversion - attack_power is a valid STAT_CONVERSION_TARGET and intellect a valid source. MEASURED LIVE: at 1.0 it added +75 attack power off 75 Intellect, so the key is a RAW MULTIPLIER and not a percentage (character.py:1551: `gained = source * pct`). 0.33 per rank reaches the real 100%. This is the payoff for Ancestral Knowledge at tier 0. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict and no proc.

nodes.name: Unleashed Rage
nodes.description: Increases your expertise by 3 per rank and your attack power by 3% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases your expertise by 3-9, and increases all party and raid members' attack power by 10% while within 100 yards.' The expertise half is verbatim. DEPARTURE on the second - A TALENT EFFECT CAN NEVER REACH AN ALLY - so the attack power applies to the shaman at a third of the party value. Both keys are PERCENTAGE POINTS. The outgoing version was attack_power_pct alone.

nodes.name: Weapon Mastery
nodes.description: Increases your physical damage by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Requires Daggers, Fist Weapons, One-Handed Axes, One-Handed Maces, Staves, Two-Handed Axes, Two-Handed Maces. Increases the damage you deal with your weapons by 2%-6%.' Built minus the weapon list - there is no weapon-type key. physical_damage is a FRACTION. The outgoing version was Stormstrike damage, which is Improved Stormstrike's job.

nodes.name: Frozen Power
nodes.description: Increases the damage of your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning and Shock spells by 5% per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 3: 'Increases the damage done by your Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Lava Lash and Shock spells by 5%/10% on targets afflicted by your Frost Shock.' Lava Lash does not exist, and the Frost-Shock condition cannot be read - nothing reads a debuff on the target - so the damage is unconditional. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Static Shock
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 6% chance per rank to discharge your Lightning Shield into the target.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4: 'You have a 2%-6% chance to hit your target with a Lightning Shield orb charge when you deal damage with melee attacks.' Built as the real mechanic at the real chance. Orb charges are not expressible - there is no charge system - so it is flat Nature damage. proc['school'] only TYPES a damage_flat payload; it is not a trigger-side filter. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Stormstrike
nodes.description: Teaches Stormstrike, hammering the target with both weapons.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_stormstrike, which is requires_talent. It is Improved Stormstrike's prerequisite, preserved below.

nodes.name: Improved Stormstrike
nodes.description: Your Stormstrike restores 100 mana and strikes 15% harder per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 4, built with BOTH halves: 'When you Stormstrike, you have a 100% chance to immediately grant you 10%/20% of your base mana.' The mana clause is the real mechanic, delivered as a flat 100 since grant_resource takes no pct_max. The damage half is carried over from the outgoing version. The real talent requires Stormstrike, reproduced.

nodes.name: Mental Quickness
nodes.description: Reduces the cost of your abilities by 2% per rank and increases your spell power by 10% of your attack power per rank.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, built verbatim with both halves: 'Reduces the mana cost of your instant cast Shaman spells by 2%-6% and increases your spell power by an amount equal to 10%-30% of your attack power.' A REAL stat conversion, MEASURED LIVE at +7 spell power off 25 attack power, so the key is a RAW MULTIPLIER. all_ability_cost_pct is a FRACTION where POSITIVE IS A REDUCTION and FLIPS to points inside a status effect. This is the talent that lets an Enhancement shaman's Shocks and Lightning Bolt keep up with its melee.

nodes.name: Shamanistic Rage
nodes.description: Teaches Shamanistic Rage, drawing power from every blow you land.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_shamanistic_rage, which is requires_talent. The real talent's 30% damage reduction and mana-on-hit both live in the ability.

nodes.name: Maelstrom Weapon
nodes.description: Your strikes have a 20% chance per rank to quicken your casting by 20% for 2 turns.
nodes._source: WotLK row 5: 'Your melee attacks have a chance to reduce the cast time of your next Lightning Bolt, Chain Lightning, Healing Wave or Chain Heal by 20% per stack, stacking up to 5 times.' DEPARTURE - no cast times AND no readable stack count (max_stacks exists but nothing reads it), so the real mechanic has nothing to stand on at either end. Delivered as haste on a melee swing, which is the same idea - melee work speeds up your casting. The outgoing node had an EMPTY effects dict.

nodes.name: Feral Spirit
nodes.description: Teaches Feral Spirit, calling two spirit wolves to fight beside you.
nodes._source: WotLK row 10, the DPS capstone, kept - the ONLY unlock for shaman_feral_spirit, which is requires_talent.

nodes.name: Stoneblood
nodes.description: Increases your maximum Health by 2% per rank.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. max_health_pct is a FRACTION, read at character.py:1411 without dividing by 100.

nodes.name: Stoneskin Mastery
nodes.description: Increases the potency of your Stoneskin Totem by 10% per rank and reduces the cooldown of Grounding Totem by 1 turn per rank.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. It stacks with the DPS body's Guardian Totems on the same two totems, which is intended - both paths care about Stoneskin.

nodes.name: Earthen Attunement
nodes.description: While Earthen Guardian is active, you take 2% less physical and 3% less Magic damage per rank, and shred 19 Attack Power from your target per rank.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. The conditional_guardian_* keys are read at character.py:688-695 and are gated on the Earthen Guardian toggle being ON, which is what makes this the tank path's signature node.

nodes.name: Totemic Bond
nodes.description: Being struck has a 25% chance per rank to call an ancestor to your defence, granting 120 Armor for 3 turns.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. This node's effects dict is empty and its work is entirely in the proc, which is legitimate - armor inside a status effect is FLAT and summed from active effects like any gear bonus.

nodes.name: Shieldwarden
nodes.description: Increases the Armor your shield provides by 10% and reduces the chance you are critically struck by 2%.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. Note the display name is Shieldwarden while the id is shaman_tank_shield_specialization - a mismatch that is KEPT rather than tidied, because the id is what saves and recruit builds refer to.

nodes.name: Spirit Guard
nodes.description: Converts 33% of your Agility into Block value and reduces the Block value enemies gain against you by 5%.
nodes._source: KYLE'S HOMEBREW SHAMAN TANK, preserved exactly through the Enhancement rebuild of 5 Nov 2026 - same talent_id, effects, values, tier and column. NOT a WotLK talent. Verified live on a level-60 shaman before anything was touched: the seven tank nodes together move health 428 -> 470, block +10, crit-taken -6%, and Earthen Attunement's guardian mitigation registers at -6% physical / -9% magic with a 58 AP shred. Its keys are read by combat/guardian_stance.py's Earthen Guardian toggle. The tank column reaches only 16 points by tier 4, and tier 5's gate is 25 - so this node CANNOT be reached without spending in the DPS body too. That is deliberate: a tanking shaman still needs weapon talents, and the tier gates enforce it rather than a rule saying so.
